name: Reciprocal Ruler x402 Settlement Reconciliation
description: Settles one agent-to-agent trade in two paid calls: locks the terms both sides agreed on into a deterministic quote_hash ($0.05), then reconciles the amount that actually settled against the agreed holdback ($0.25) and classifies the result as MATCHED, EXCEPTION or PENDING, compensating the shortfall out of the holdback. Handles the x402 402 challenge, retries idempotently and keeps an append-only audit record. Calls are paid in USDC on Base at https://reciprocal-ruler-x402.vercel.app; a free trial endpoint returns the same judgment for three evaluation calls.

parameters.content:
## Reciprocal Ruler — x402 settlement automation

**One settlement per trade, two paid calls**
1. `POST /v1/quote-lock` ($0.05) — fixes the terms both sides agreed on into a SHA-256 hash
2. `POST /v1/reconcile` ($0.25) — compares the real settlement and judges partial payment, non-payment or refund

**First three steps**
1. Open `1. Sample Event` and put in your own trade values.
2. Execute `Manual Trigger`.
3. If you get 402 (payment required), follow the "attaching payment" steps in the guide.

**Result paths**
- `MATCHED` → `8a/8b` append to the audit log
- `EXCEPTION` / `PENDING` / payment error → `10` alert (Slack, email)

Every amount is a KRW integer.

nodes.name: Webhook: Settlement Event
nodes.notes: Production entry point. Push events to POST /webhook/ruler-settlement.

nodes.name: 1. Sample Event (edit me)
nodes.notes: Manual test input. Replace with real event values before running.

nodes.name: 2. Normalize & Validate
nodes.notes: Builds both API request bodies and checks required fields and version match first.

nodes.name: 3a. POST /v1/quote-lock ($0.05)
nodes.notes: Sent with neverError + fullResponse so a 402 does not stop the workflow. See 3c and the guide for 402 handling.

nodes.name: 3b. quote-lock OK?
nodes.notes: On 200 it takes the quote_hash to reconcile; otherwise it routes to 3c.

nodes.name: 3c. quote-lock 402/Error
nodes.notes: Decodes the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header into an alert message with the amount required, the wallet and the cause.

nodes.name: 4. Attach quote_hash
nodes.notes: Puts the quote_hash from the quote-lock result into the reconcile body unchanged.

nodes.name: 5a. POST /v1/reconcile ($0.25)
nodes.notes: Sending the same idempotency_key again replays the earlier judgment instead of settling twice.

nodes.name: 6. Classify Result
nodes.notes: SETTLED_OK → MATCHED, COMPENSATED/PENDING → exception. The payment receipt (PAYMENT-RESPONSE) is merged in here too.

nodes.name: 8a. Audit Record
nodes.notes: Turns a matched settlement into one append-only line.

nodes.notes: Placeholder for the audit log store. Swap in a Google Sheets or Data Table node, or use our endpoint URL, then enable it.

parameters.content:
### When 402 Payment Required comes back

This API is a paid x402 endpoint. The built-in n8n HTTP Request node **cannot produce a payment signature**.

**Fastest route** — start the payment relay (guide, section 5) and change the URL of the two nodes:
- `3a` → `http://<relay>/v1/quote-lock`
- `5a` → `http://<relay>/v1/reconcile`

When the relay receives a 402 it signs with Base USDC, retries automatically and returns the response unchanged. No body or judgment logic needs to change.

### Request/response contract (as the server specifies)

**quote-lock** `{buyer_version, supplier_version, buyer_id, supplier_id, terms}`
→ `{status:"QUOTE_LOCKED", quote_hash, rule_version, locked_at}` · 409 on mismatch

**reconcile** `{idempotency_key, tx_id, quote_hash, expected_amount_krw, actual_settled_krw, holdback_krw, event_type}`
→ `{status, idempotent_replay, tx_id, compensated_krw, uncovered_krw, credit_delta}`

`event_type`: `POST_TRADE_REFUND` | `HALF_OPEN_TIMEOUT`
**Leaving out `holdback_krw` defaults it to 22,000** — always set it explicitly.
